name: Indiana
permitAge: 15 if enrolled in an approved driver education course; 16 without driver education

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, logged on State Form 54706 (BMV); required for all new drivers 18 or younger, even with driver education
teen.nightLimit: Probationary license: first 180 days no driving 10 p.m. to 5 a.m.; after that until 18, not after 11 p.m. Sunday to Thursday and not 1 a.m. to 5 a.m. Saturday and Sunday mornings. Exceptions: work, school-sanctioned activity, religious event, or a qualifying adult in the front seat
teen.passengerLimit: Probationary license, first 180 days: no passengers unless a licensed instructor, a licensed driver 25 or older, or a spouse 21 or older is in the front seat; own child, stepchild, sibling or spouse allowed
teen.phone: Probationary drivers: no telecommunication device at all, except to call 911. All drivers: hands-free law since July 1, 2020 (no holding a phone, tablet or smartwatch-type device; 911 exception).

bac.under21: 0.02 (from 2001 bill text and a 2011 legal guide; current Indiana Code section not confirmed)

notes: Learner supervisor for a learner under 18: licensed relative 25 or older, spouse 21 or older, or a licensed driver education instructor / driver rehabilitation specialist (BMV learner permit page).

A 15-year-old in driver education may practice with a parent only after 30 hours of the classroom or online portion and enrollment in a BMV-licensed behind-the-wheel program (BMV driver education page).
Probationary license age: 16 with driver education, 16 years 270 days without. Expires 30 days after the 21st birthday.

Knowledge exam: two sections (traffic maneuvers/rules and traffic signs), 80 percent on each section (BMV knowledge exam page). Commercial sites say 50 questions (34 rules + 16 signs); not confirmed by BMV, so questions is null.
Move over (IC 9-21-8-35): change lanes away from a stopped emergency, authorized amber-light or hazard-light vehicle; if not possible, slow to 10 mph below the posted limit. Class B infraction.
School bus (IC 9-21-12-3): no stop needed when the bus is on the opposite side of a highway divided by a barrier, unimproved median or constructed dividing section.
Spanish handbook and Spanish knowledge test: not found in this session. WebFetch to state sites blocked; all facts are from search-result summaries of the pages listed.
